invariants.name: journal balanced
invariants.covers: a journal whose debits and credits differ was accepted

invariants.name: posting log intact
invariants.covers: a posting was altered or removed after it was written

invariants.name: projection equals rebuild
invariants.covers: the cached balance drifted from the postings that determine it

invariants.name: no orphan postings
invariants.covers: a journal and its postings were torn apart, by a partial write or a retention sweep

invariants.name: reversal nets to zero
invariants.covers: a correction that did not actually undo what it claimed to undo

invariants.name: currency consistent
invariants.covers: two currencies summed into one account balance

invariants.name: period and time separation
invariants.covers: a backdated entry that lost its recorded time, or landed in a closed period

invariants.name: trial balance
invariants.covers: an imbalance spread across several journals that each look fine alone

invariants.name: business reference unique
invariants.covers: the same real-world event posted twice under two journal ids
